extraction.name: WebWalkerQA
extraction.description: A benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal, evaluating the capacity to traverse a website's subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We employ a two-stage funnel annotation strategy, combining LLM-based and human annotation. In the first stage, GPT-4o performs initial annotations, followed by a second stage, where crowd-sourced human annotators conduct quality control and filtering to refine the final results.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Official websites across conference, organization, education, and game domains.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Traverse official websites recursively, collecting information on accessible sub-links and their respective pages. Construct queries based on the provided page information and specified role. Verify and filter for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: LLM-based annotation using GPT-4o to generate synthetic QA-pairs based on gathered information, followed by manual verification by crowd-sourced human annotators to ensure accuracy and relevance.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset size is limited to 680 high-quality QA pairs. Only utilizes HTML-DOM to parse clickable buttons, not visual modalities. WebWalker is driven by prompting without additional training.
